description: Authoritative Scripture & Christian Symbolism Concordance for faith apparel and life seasons. Use when someone asks 'What Bible verses are good for anxiety / courage / gym discipline / grief / baptism / new beginnings?', 'What does Est. 33 AD / Holy Ground / Armor of God / More Than Conquerors / Tetelestai / Second Wind mean?', or 'List all Bible verses available on Christian clothing'. Returns theological & historical context plus verified live ArmorNGlory pieces carrying that verse or symbol.

limit.description: Max concordance entries or products to include (default: 6)

query.description: Optional Bible verse (e.g. 'Romans 8:37', 'Psalm 23', '1 Peter 2:9'), Christian symbol ('33 AD', 'Armor of God', 'Holy Ground', 'Sacred Symbols'), or life theme/emotion ('anxiety', 'courage', 'gym', 'running', 'baptism', 'grief', 'purpose'). Omit to view the full Scripture Concordance index.

name: explore_scripture_and_symbolism
